chapter: Bebop, Tadd Dameron, Slam Stewart and Europe
title: Slam Stewart trio, Billy Taylor and Beryl Booker
summary: After the army Collins joined Slam Stewart's group with Billy Taylor; Taylor was fired after his honeymoon and replaced by Beryl Booker.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Slam Stewart. Let's see, Billy Taylor, Slam Stewart, Doc West and myself, we had this like that.
Slam Stewart. Slam was very big then too, incidently, and he did some very good things. We did quite a bit of recording too, incidently. On what labels?

Music Craft. And most of them were on Music Craft. And Billy left, and I'll tell you -- Billy got fired, really, and I never did appreciate it. Billy got married, and he went on his honeymoon and when he came back he didn't have a job. So I was furious with Slam because I'd left him. But Slam had heard a piano player, a girl and in Philadelphia by the name of Beryl Booker, who was a monster. And he literally paid Billy off, you know, and in order to keep this girl, you know, which we -- I enjoyed playing with Beryl. Beryl was a beautiful pianist. Now you're speaking of chords now, here we go again. She was something else.
